evals.prompt: Add a POST /api/v1/staff/events/{eventId}/ticket-types endpoint. Price and capacity must be positive. Return the created ticket type.
evals.expected_output: Handler validates price/capacity before service call (400 VALIDATION_FAILED). Success uses envelope with bare ticket type in data, error null, request_id present. Domain duplicate-name error from service mapped to 409.

evals.prompt: The checkout endpoint needs to return a proper error when a customer tries to buy more tickets than remain. Wire it up.
evals.expected_output: sales.ErrCapacityExceeded in service layer. Handler maps to 409 with CAPACITY_EXCEEDED code, UI-safe message, details with ticket_type_id/requested/remaining. Standard envelope.

evals.prompt: Review this handler - it calls the service first and validates price inside CreateTicketType. Is that right?
evals.expected_output: Flag validation in service as wrong layer. Recommend moving field validation to handler (400 VALIDATION_FAILED). Service keeps DB-dependent rules only.
